recognize_zh: 皮膚真皮內可見中型不成熟細胞沿膠原束之間呈單排或小片浸潤，核卵圓至不規則、染色質細緻，細胞質少量淡染；其間散布許多深染的核碎片凋亡小體（apoptotic bodies），右側仍保存附屬器上皮。這種在膠原間穿插浸潤的母細胞，是白血病皮膚浸潤（leukemia cutis）的樣子。
features: Dermal infiltrate of medium-sized immature cells dissecting between collagen bundles in single files and small sheets, denser toward the right
Oval to irregular, occasionally folded nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin and small nucleoli
Scant to moderate pale amphophilic cytoplasm
Numerous interspersed apoptotic bodies and karyorrhectic nuclear debris
Adnexal epithelium at the right edge; epidermis not included; no granulomas or vasculitis
describe_en: Skin biopsy shows a diffuse dermal infiltrate of medium-sized mononuclear cells that percolate between collagen bundles in single files and form denser sheets adjacent to an adnexal structure. The cells have oval to irregular nuclei with fine chromatin, small nucleoli and scant pale cytoplasm, with numerous interspersed apoptotic bodies and karyorrhectic debris. The pattern of interstitial infiltration with blastic cytology is not typical of a reactive dermatitis. Immunohistochemistry (MPO, lysozyme, CD33, CD68, CD117, and cytoplasmic NPM1) is needed for lineage confirmation. In a patient with AML, findings are consistent with leukemia cutis.

ddx.vs: Also presents as a dermal blastic infiltrate, often sparing the epidermis, but is CD4/CD56/CD123/TCF4 positive and MPO/lysozyme negative.

ddx.dx: Primary cutaneous or systemic large B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Cells are larger with vesicular nuclei and prominent nucleoli and express CD20/PAX5 rather than myeloid markers.
The infiltrate consists of immature-appearing MPO-positive myeloid cells with papillary dermal edema and lacks blast-level atypia and a clonal genetic lesion.
Shows cohesive sheets with salt-and-pepper chromatin and nuclear molding and is CK20 dot-positive and CD45-negative.
